description_en: Removes application environment variables. This operation supports only PolarClaw
description_zh:
删除应用环境变量

目前仅支持PolarClaw
kebab_example: aliyun polardb remove-application-environment-variables --application-id pa-00000000000000000000 --variable-names TEST_ENV --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveApplicationEnvironmentVariables

parameters.help_en: A list of the environment variable names to remove
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的环境变量名列表
parameters.name: variable_names

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after removing the variables. The default is `true`
parameters.help_zh: 删除后是否重启网关，默认true
parameters.name: restart
